settings.poll_interval_sec.label: Polling interval (seconds)
settings.poll_interval_sec.description: How often the service queries niri for the window list (10–600 s).
settings.idle_timeout_min.label: Idle timeout (minutes)
settings.idle_timeout_min.description: How long a watched window may stay unfocused before the first reminder is sent (1–240 min).
settings.repeat_interval_min.label: Repeat reminders (minutes)
settings.repeat_interval_min.description: Send a follow-up reminder every N minutes until the window is focused again. 0 disables repeats (one reminder per window).
settings.auto_close_after_reminders.desc: Automatically close a window (niri msg action close-window) after N reminders. 0 disables auto-close — the plugin only reminds.
settings.watch_list.label: Watch list
settings.watch_list.description: Comma-separated app classes or title fragments to watch, e.g. 'alacritty, kitty, firefox'.
settings.quiet_start_hour.label: Quiet hours — start (hour)
settings.quiet_start_hour.description: No reminders (and no auto-close) starting from this hour. Use -1 to disable quiet hours.
settings.quiet_end_hour.label: Quiet hours — end (hour)
settings.quiet_end_hour.description: Quiet hours end at this hour. Use -1 to disable quiet hours. The range may cross midnight (e.g. 23 → 7).
